title: Learning-augmented smooth integer programs with PAC-learnable oracles
abstract: arXiv:2602.02505v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study an end-to-end learning-augmented framework for smooth integer programs, a broad class of Boolean polynomial optimization problems including MAX-CUT and MAX-k-SAT. An oracle learned from sampled instances predicts a full Boolean assignment for each unseen instance. For fixed-degree objectives, our polynomial-time pipeline, LEAP, linearizes the objective around the predicted assignment, solves an error-budgeted linear program, and rounds the fractional solution. We establish two guarantees. First, for any prediction, the approximation loss of LEAP degrades gracefully with prediction error: it is controlled by an error footprint that quantifies how much mispredicted coordinates can perturb the objective's local coefficients. translated_title: 具有PAC可学习预言机的学习增强平滑整数规划
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一个针对平滑整数规划的端到端学习增强框架，平滑整数规划是一类广泛的布尔多项式优化问题，包括MAX-CUT和MAX-k-SAT。通过从采样实例中学习得到的预言机为每个未见过的实例预测一个完整的布尔赋值。对于固定次数的目标函数，我们的多项式时间流水线LEAP围绕预测赋值对目标函数进行线性化，求解一个带误差预算的线性规划，并对分数解进行舍入。我们建立了两项保证。首先，对于任何预测，LEAP的近似损失会随预测误差而优雅退化：它由一个误差足迹所控制，该足迹量化了误预测的坐标在多大程度上会扰动目标函数的局部系数。其次，我们界定了LEAP诱导的代价类的伪维度，从而通过在来自某分布的实例上进行经验风险最小化来学习预言机，为此提供了PAC风格的保证。
tldr: 本文提出了一个名为LEAP的多项式时间学习增强框架用于求解平滑整数规划问题，证明了其近似损失随预测误差优雅退化，并通过伪维度分析给出了学习预言机的PAC泛化保证。
en_tdlr: We propose LEAP, a polynomial-time learning-augmented framework for smooth integer programs, whose approximation loss degrades gracefully with prediction error and whose oracle learning enjoys PAC-style guarantees via pseudo-dimension bounds.
